proposal.summary: A buffer overrun (heap-based out-of-bounds read) in OpenSC's pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package when parsing a malformed ASN.1 smart card package due to incorrect remaining-length calculation caused by a moved starting pointer; may crash with ASAN and could lead to information leak or further damage.
proposal.cwe_quote: This security flaw cause a buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package.

AV.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

AC.quote: The cardos_have_verifyrc_package function scans the ASN1 buffer for 2 tags, where remaining length is wrongly caculated due to moved starting pointer.

PR.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

UI.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

S.quote: This security flaw cause a buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package.

C.quote: Further info leak or more damage is possible.

A.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vulnerable OpenSC version and a minimal reproducer or PoC ASN.1 package, confirm the out-of-bounds read and crash behavior, and determine impact (info leak vs arbitrary code) to produce a fix and advisory.
